observations: White game console with a glossy top surface.
Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' sit on top of the console.
A black power cable with a UK-style plug is visible.
A black HDMI cable is coiled on the console.
The console has a matte finish on the sides and a glossy finish on the top.
The console is resting on a cardboard box.
A watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICIAL' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The console's model is not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware fault or be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A video of the console successfully connecting to a TV and navigating the system menu.

risks.risk: The controller boxes may be empty or contain third-party controllers.
risks.proof: A photo of the controllers outside of the boxes.

risks.risk: The console may be a third-party clone rather than a genuine Sony PlayStation 4 Pro.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number on the back of the console.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powered on and navigating the system menu.
Photo of the controllers outside of the boxes.
Photo of the model number on the back of the console.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
